author: Kaitlin Howell
title: Dr. Bonita Coleman named interim Canton superintendent - NewsBreak
text:
By Kaitlin Howell ,
9 hours ago CANTON, Miss. ( WJTV ) - The Canton Public School Board of Trustees appointed Dr. Bonita R. Coleman as the Canton Public School District's (CPSD) new interim superintendent.
According to the district, Coleman has more than three decades of experience leading complex K–12 systems at the local, state and national levels. She has served as a former superintendent, deputy superintendent, state education executive, teacher, university professor and executive coach.
Vicksburg Warren School District implements new electronic devices policy Coleman served for 10 years as superintendent of the Ocean Springs School District. Under her leadership, officials said the district consistently maintained an A accountability rating beginning in 2013, and all district schools maintained A ratings beginning in 2018–2019.
“It is an honor to be selected to serve the students and families of Canton Public School District. I look forward to working with leaders and teachers to continue to assess CPS’s organizational needs and maintain a strong focus on teaching and learning and operational efficiency," said Coleman.
Dr. Bonita R. Coleman (Courtesy: CPSD) Coleman earned her Ph.D. from Jackson State University, a master's degree from the University of Mississippi and a bachelor's degree from Tougaloo College. She also completed a post-doctoral fellowship through the Broad Superintendents Academy.
Former CPSD Superintendent Dwight Luckett, Sr., served for more than a year as the interim superintendent . The district said he gave the school board three weeks' notice that he was leaving.
"CPSD will be forever grateful for his dedicated commitment to our district after serving for eight years as superintendent and being asked to serve twice as interim over the years," officials said.
